_note: One example sentence per word. The game reads the word, the sentence, then the word again (as the PDF's instructions ask). On screen the word is replaced by a gap. Every word in homophone and apostrophe weeks MUST have a sentence, because the word alone is ambiguous when spoken. Words with no sentence fall back to 'Spell <word>.'
